name: outcome
wording: the lead's handoff when a user story or a task with no story ends: merged or dropped, each criterion with its evidence, meaning questions raised, follow-ups, cost against the rough cost; the architect accepts the story done once it has experienced the realization of the story's meaning, the outcome guiding it there, never standing in for it; anything unfinished is a follow-up, never an open state
reason: A story is done when the realization of its meaning can be experienced; the lead's account of the work is evidence, never the experience itself.
